name: write_module_source
description: Writes BSL source into a 1C metadata object module. Eight modes pick a whole-module replacement or a point edit; the mode argument names them. Before the write, a BSL syntax pass verifies that Procedure/EndProcedure, Function/EndFunction, If/EndIf and similar pairs stay balanced - any mismatch blocks the write. Pass skipSyntaxCheck=true to override it. Set dryRun=true to preview the outcome without writing anything.

projectName.description: Name of the EDT project to work in

modulePath.description: Path to the module from the src/ folder, e.g. 'CommonModules/MyModule/Module.bsl'; a leading 'src/' is stripped. A write refuses a misspelled kind folder or an object the configuration does not hold, naming the canonical path. Or supply objectName + moduleType instead.

objectName.description: The object's fully-qualified name, e.g. 'Document.MyDoc'. Metadata names in Russian work too. An alternative to modulePath.

moduleType.description: Module kind, paired with objectName: ObjectModule (default), ManagerModule, FormModule, CommandModule, RecordSetModule.

source.description: The BSL text to write (aliases accepted: content, sourceCode, code, text). Needed for every mode EXCEPT replaceMethods, where each method brings its own source inside the methods[] array. For replace: the module's entire new content. For searchReplace: what to put in place of oldSource. For append: the text being added. For replaceMethod/replaceMethods: the full method. A leading // header comment takes the place of the method's existing header comment (never leaving a duplicate); without one, the old header is left alone. To drop a header without a new one, use searchReplace instead.

oldSource.description: Fragment to find and swap (required for searchReplace mode); it must match exactly one spot, which is also proof you actually read the current file contents.

mode.description: Write mode: 'searchReplace' (find oldSource and swap in source; the default), 'replace' (overwrite the entire file), 'append' (add text at the end), 'replaceLines' (overwrite a range of lines), 'replaceMethod' (swap out one named method end-to-end), 'replaceMethods' (atomic multi-method swap - see methods[]; every target must be found, or nothing gets written), 'insertBefore' (source ahead of line N), 'insertAfter' (source right after line N).

formName.description: The form's name; required when moduleType=FormModule.

commandName.description: The command's name; required when moduleType=CommandModule.

lineFrom.description: Starting line for replaceLines mode (1-based, inclusive)

lineTo.description: Ending line for replaceLines mode (1-based, inclusive)

expectedText.description: Safety net for replaceLines: the text you believe sits on lines lineFrom..lineTo. If it does not match (the module changed since you read it, so the lines are stale), the edit gets REJECTED and you get an expected-vs-actual diff instead of a silent overwrite of the wrong lines.

methodName.description: The method's name for replaceMethod mode (looked up as a Procedure/Function by that name). The replaced span also picks up preceding &-directives and the old // header comment when the new source opens with one.

methods.description: In replaceMethods mode, supply a JSON array of {methodName, source} objects, e.g. [{"methodName":"X","source":"..."}]. Every referenced method has to already exist, or the call writes nothing (all-or-nothing). Per entry, 'name' works as an alias for methodName, and content/sourceCode/code/text are all accepted as aliases for source.

line.description: 1-based line number for insertBefore/insertAfter. insertBefore places source right before line N (the old line N moves down to N+sourceLines); insertAfter places it right after line N (the old line N+1 moves further down).

dryRun.description: Previews the write without touching the file. Reports diff stats (linesBefore, linesAfter, removedLines, addedLines)

normalizeInvalidCharacters.description: Replaces dashes, no-break spaces and soft hyphens outside string literals with plain characters and reports where. Default: true.

skipSyntaxCheck.description: Bypasses the BSL syntax check (default: false). At the default it confirms balanced Procedure/EndProcedure, Function/EndFunction, If/EndIf, While/EndDo, For/EndDo, Try/EndTry pairs. Set true to push the write through regardless.

validateAfterWrite.description: Runs EDT validation after a successful write and folds the outcome into the response (default: true). Adds a 'validation' section with errors / warnings / codeStyle counts, plus a hint. Pass false while writing in a batch and call get_project_errors once at the end instead.

confirmFullReplace.description: Has to be true when a write would strip away more than 50% of an existing module's lines; this prevents an accidental stub replacement from silently wiping a large module. Removals above 30% still proceed but come back with a non-blocking 'protection' warning. Applies to every mode that can remove lines - searchReplace, replaceLines, replaceMethod, replaceMethods and replace (a replace that strips more than half still has to be confirmed); the additive modes (append, insertBefore, insertAfter) only add lines and are never gated.
